name: LIKE LIE CRY
source:
---I couldn't be your first---

For college, Hisashi Makino moved back to Shinamachi,
the place where he fell in love for the first time.
Back then he'd never made a connection with that girl.
He was determined not to let opportunity pass twice.

A new life in Shinamachi. A new relationship. How will Hisashi change?
At age 18 his identity is still forming. Should he forget about old feelings?
Will he rouse himself to fulfill a longtime wish?

Like Lie Cry is an emotional story about shining the light
on many people's feelings from "back then".

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ125981.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
---我不可能是你的第一个---

为了上大学，牧野恒搬回了品町，
他第一次坠入爱河的地方。
那时他还没有和那个女孩产生过任何联系。
他下定决心，不会再让机会错失两次。

品町的新生活。一种新的关系。尚志会发生怎样的变化呢？
18岁时，他的身份仍在形成。难道他应该忘记旧情吗？
他会激励自己完成长久以来的愿望吗？

《Like Lie Cry》是一个关于闪耀光芒的情感故事
关于很多人“当年”的感受。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ125981.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
